:::{#def-kl-divergence}
#### Kullback--Leibler divergence (KL divergence, relative entropy)

For $X$, $p$ and $q$ as in @def-cross-entropy,
the **Kullback--Leibler divergence** (**KL divergence**, or **relative entropy**)
of $q$ from $p$ is the [expectation](#def-expectation),
when $X$ has [distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-cdf) $p$,
of the amount by which the [surprisal under $q$](#def-surprisal-under) of $X$ exceeds its surprisal under $p$:

$$\kldivf{p}{q} \eqdef \Expfc{X \sim p}{\surprisalunderf{q}{X} - \surprisalunderf{p}{X}}.$$

As for [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy),
the divergence is infinite when $\P(q(X) = 0) > 0$,
because $\surprisalunderf{q}{x} = \infty$ when $q(x) = 0$.

:::
